settings.body:
We aim to deliver every order quickly and securely across the UK.

Standard UK Delivery — £3.95

Free UK Delivery — Orders over £75

Orders over £75 qualify automatically for free standard delivery.

Order Tracking

You will receive a shipping confirmation with tracking information once your order has been dispatched.
